title: PixelKin - The Mirelights (SNES register)
_note: The Mirelights / the Glassmere (09-the-wild-ways §2B): a drowned causeway-field where wandering false blue lights lure boats astray - the echoes of the fen's own lamp-kin, put to sleep in a null-lantern. Eerie but tender. 72 BPM, 3/4 (the Tide signature's lilting triple metre), B minor with a Neapolitan C in the B section. Sparse SNES register: pulse25 lead long-toned and widely spaced; the BELL track is the false lights - whole-tone motes (C D E F# G# A#) that drift off-key and off the beat; soft strings pad; a pluck harp only once the lights start leading you (B, A'); a slow noise breath = water at the stilts. Vesper motif: A states the lift F#4->B4->C#5 and WITHHOLDS the settle; A' lets it land, F#5-E5-D5 over D major, while the bell rings one single in-key D6 - the true light remembered. 24 bars = 60 s. Original (VISION.md).
